not_validated: Fusion was NOT validated. No dataset pairs a face image and a Sinhala message from the same person at the same moment with a ground-truth mood label, so no accuracy, macro-F1, or confusion matrix for fusion exists or is reported. F13 is a weight-sensitivity sweep on SYNTHETIC evidence, not a validation.
